request.initial_prompt: Othello. Was this fair paper, this most goodly book, Made to write "whore" upon? What committed? Committed! O thou public commoner! I should make very forges of my cheeks, That would to cinders burn up modesty, Did I but speak thy deeds. What committed! Heaven stops the nose at it, and the moon winks; The bawdy wind, that kisses all it meets, Is hush'd within the hollow mine of earth, And will not hear it. What committed! Impudent strumpet!
request.hotwords: Othello, Was, Made, What, O, I, Did, Heaven, Is, Impudent
